text: Screen title ("Receipts"): Title renders at ~40px display size, flush to the very top with no safe-area inset, so it is visually clipped and overpowers the content; desktop shows no top padding either. Expected after the fix: Create src/components/ui/ScreenHeader.tsx used by every screen: <View style={{paddingTop: insets.top + 16, paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingBottom: 16}}><Text variant="headlineMedium">{title}</Text></View> using useSafeAreaInsets(); remove per-screen title styles.

Receipt card body: Four stacked lines of near-identical bodyLarge text with "Date:"/"Category:" prefixes; no visual hierarchy, card is taller than it needs to be. Expected after the fix: Restructure ReceiptCard content to: row 1 = amount Text variant="titleLarge" (left) + type Chip (right); row 2 = Text variant="bodySmall" color onSurfaceVariant with "2026-11-12 · Supplies" (drop the label prefixes); row 3 = note Text variant="bodyMedium" onSurfaceVariant. Card padding 16, gap 4 between rows.

"Expense" label: Plain teal primary-colored text looks like a tappable link and competes with the amount. Expected after the fix: Replace with <Chip compact mode="flat" textStyle={{fontSize:12}} style={{backgroundColor: theme.colors.secondaryContainer}}>Expense</Chip> with onSecondaryContainer text; never use colors.primary for non-interactive labels.

"[photo attached]" text: Bracketed italic placeholder text reads as debug output and uses primary color. Expected after the fix: Replace with a row: <Icon source="paperclip" size={16} color={theme.colors.onSurfaceVariant} /> + Text variant="bodySmall" onSurfaceVariant "Photo attached", 8px gap, 8px top margin.

Primary action: Large empty area below the two cards and no way to add a receipt from this screen, breaking the "always offer the next action" rule. Expected after the fix: Add Paper <FAB icon="plus" label="Add receipt" /> positioned absolute right:16, bottom: tabBarHeight + 16, and set list contentContainerStyle paddingBottom: 96 so the last card isn't covered.

Page content container (desktop): On 1280px the content stays in a narrow ~390px column while the bottom tab bar stretches edge to edge, so the desktop view looks like a blown-up phone. Expected after the fix: Add src/components/ui/ScreenContainer.tsx wrapping all screen bodies: <View style={{flex:1, width:'100%', maxWidth: 840, alignSelf:'center', paddingHorizontal: 24}}>; apply the same maxWidth/alignSelf to the bottom navigation bar's inner row.

Card elevation / list spacing: Cards use a soft drop shadow on a grey background with inconsistent 16/24 gaps, giving a dated look. Expected after the fix: In theme.ts set Card default to mode="elevated" elevation={1} and roundness 3 (12px); in the list use ItemSeparatorComponent with height 16 and contentContainerStyle paddingTop 8 — remove ad-hoc card margins.

Bottom navigation labels: Active and inactive tabs are both colored teal-ish with no active indicator pill, so current location is unclear. Expected after the fix: Use Paper BottomNavigation.Bar styling: activeColor = colors.onSecondaryContainer with the pill indicator enabled, inactiveColor = colors.onSurfaceVariant, labels at labelMedium (12px), bar height 80 with safe-area bottom inset.
